title: RGS Stage 10 Post-Generation Scrutiny Results and Required Amendments

Altintas stability-lobe formula referenced but never specified — add a_lim = -1/(2*Ks*Re[G(jw)])
Chip thinning sqrt(ae/D) approximation bound not documented — specify valid for ae/D < 0.5
Hook cascade total claimed 86, actual 79 — discrepancy of 7
Skill cascade total claimed 96, actual 84 — discrepancy of 12
MS4 creates separate camAgiDispatcher.ts breaking unified cadCamDeepAgiDispatcher cascade contract
MS4 path prefix inconsistency (src/ vs mcp-server/src/)
U-DAMPP05 CycleTimeMinimizerEngine needs explicit check_toolpath_collision dispatcher call + S(x) gate
U-DAAE08 MachineCommOverrideBridgeEngine needs token-bucket rate-limit, mTLS, deadman-timeout, replay-nonce
MS6 units rely on 'behavior deviation' metrics only — missing explicit SafetyEngine S(x) gate wiring
MS5/MS6 numbering inversion (execution MS5 logically needs post-processed G-code from MS6)
Missing DuplicationGuard citations for AdaptiveControlEngine reuse in MS5
MS3→MS2 tolerance feedback edge missing
MS7 state machine needs degraded-mode transitions (sensor loss, post failure, fixture fault)
MS0 and MS4 schema inconsistency — 30/96 units lack tests_required and coverage_target fields
U-DAAE09 40-hour burn-in operationally risky — add shadow-mode replay clause
U-DAE2E05 (24,545 programs in < 24hr) needs per-program timeout, parallelism factor, memory ceiling
MS3 'coverage_target 100%' aspirational — lower to 99% for mutation-testing realism
No train/validation/test split specified for MS0 transformer or MS1 idiom embeddings
No overfitting mitigation (dropout, weight decay, early stopping, regularization)
Corpus 24,545 parts ≈ 6M tokens, insufficient for from-scratch transformer (need pretrain-from-CodeT5/StarCoder)
RL policy unspecified (MS4 U-CAMAGI02) — must declare PPO/Q-learning/policy-gradient + reward function

A2_physics_formula_provenance.action: Add provenance comment to RPM exponent 0.3 — derived from Taylor tool-life exponent n ≈ 0.25-0.35 for carbide (ISO 3685; Sandvik HSM machining handbook p.42). Define ae_ref = nominal radial engagement at original programmed stepover.

A3_stability_lobe_formula.action: Add explicit Altintas formula: a_lim = -1/(2*Ks*Re[G(jw)]) where Ks = specific cutting pressure, G(jw) = cross-axis FRF. Reference Altintas 'Manufacturing Automation' 2nd ed. Ch. 4.

A4_chip_thinning_bounds.action: Replace sqrt(ae/D) with full form: hm = fz*sqrt(ae/D*(1-ae/D)) for ae/D < 0.5, arcsin form for ae/D >= 0.5. Document approximation error bound: simplified sqrt form underestimates by ~10% near 50% engagement.

A5_ml_methodology_annex.target_file: CADCAM-DAGI-MS0.json (new section: ml_methodology), MS1.json, MS4.json, MS7.json
A5_ml_methodology_annex.action: Add ML methodology annex: temporal 70/15/15 train/val/test split (no random split — CAD evolves); 5-fold CV; dropout 0.1, weight decay 1e-4, early-stop patience 5; pretrain from CodeT5/StarCoder then finetune with LoRA; RL: PPO with clipped objective, gamma=0.99, GAE lambda=0.95; Kalman: declare F (state transition), H (observation), Q (process noise), R (measurement noise) matrices; upgrade to UKF for nonlinear cutting force model; MS7 benchmark: sample size n >= 385 for 95% CI with 5% margin, Wilson interval, paired McNemar test vs human baseline; CAD metrics: validity%, Chamfer-L2, feature-F1, parametric-consistency score.

A6_safety_hardening.action_U-DAAE08: Add token-bucket rate-limit (<= 10 overrides/sec), mTLS spec, deadman-timeout (abort if no ACK in 200ms), replay-nonce (monotonic counter in HMAC).
A6_safety_hardening.action_U-DAMPP05: Add explicit prism_safety.check_toolpath_collision dispatcher call + S(x) >= 0.70 gate before rapid reorder commit. Hard-fail on Z-safety-plane violation.

A7_schema_normalization.action: Backfill tests_required (int, 10-35) and coverage_target (string, '90%'-'100%') fields on all 30 units to match MS1/2/3/5/6/7 schema.

A8_burn_in_derisk.action: Split 40-hour burn-in into (a) 40-hour shadow-mode replay on recorded telemetry (offline, safe) + (b) 8-hour live machine burn-in on vetted test parts. Both must pass for gate.

A9_corpus_regression_budget.action: Add: per-program timeout 30s, parallelism factor 100 concurrent, memory ceiling 4GB/worker, retry policy (3 attempts, exponential backoff). Throughput budget: 24,545 / (100 * 30s) ≈ 122min = ~2hr expected, 24hr upper bound.

A10_duplication_guard_citations.action: Per existing PRISM directive (CLAUDE.md 'AWARE-MS0'): add DuplicationGuardEngine.checkBeforeCreating() call in loop_1_build for each new engine. Especially: MS5 U-DAAE04 must check against existing AdaptiveControlEngine (1,660-engine base).

amendment_execution_strategy: Amendments A1 (cascade totals), A5 (ML annex), A6 (safety hardening), A7 (schema normalization) are BLOCKING — must be applied before first-unit execution begins. Amendments A2-A4, A8-A10 are PER-UNIT — applied during loop_1_build of each affected unit as part of 4-LOOP protocol.
re_scrutiny_trigger: After BLOCKING amendments applied, re-run ML review (currently 58, must reach >= 70). If ML still < 70, escalate to human ML specialist before execution.
next_action: Apply BLOCKING amendments A1/A5/A6/A7 to respective milestone files, then begin execution.
